title: 51resources
description: A language resource pack that provides 10‑language translations for the three Labor Day datapacks (51happy, 51happily, 51happier). Enables fully localized advancement titles, descriptions, chat messages, and titles.
body:
This resource pack is the companion translation pack for the Labor Day datapack series. It contains all custom translation keys used by the three datapacks.

· Supported languages: English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Arabic.
· Covers: Achievement texts, login greeting, furnace boost notification, reward titles & subtitles.
· Usage: Place in resourcepacks folder and enable alongside the three datapacks.
· Compatibility: Minecraft 1.19.2+. Works on both client and server (client‑side only).

Without this pack, players will see raw translation keys (e.g., advancement.51happy.glorious_labor.title). Install it for a polished, localized experience.

---

本资源包是劳动节数据包系列的配套翻译包，包含三个数据包使用的所有自定义翻译键。

· 支持的语言：英语、简繁中文、日语、韩语、德语、法语、西班牙语、俄语、阿拉伯语。
· 覆盖内容：成就文本、登录祝福、熔炉加速提示、奖励标题与副标题。
· 使用方法：放入 resourcepacks 文件夹，并与三个数据包同时启用。
· 兼容性：Minecraft 1.19.2+，纯客户端资源包。

若不安装本资源包，玩家将看到原始翻译键（如 advancement.51happy.glorious_labor.title）。安装后即可获得完整的本地化体验。
